long_biography.plain_text:
After earning degrees in chemical engineering at the National Technical University of Athens and business administration at the Athens University of Economics, Theoklitos completed an MBA at Imperial College London. He began at Greece's national investment bank, then moved through Egnatia Bank, the Bank of Central Greece and Hellenic Postbank, developing a broad record in banking leadership.

At National Bank of Greece he served as group chief operating officer, deputy chief executive and chairman of Ethniki Insurance. He later became managing director of food distributor ELGEKA before joining The Mart, a wholesale food, beverage and professional-equipment business, as chief executive. His career links institutional banking, corporate operations and Greek cash-and-carry retail.
